inference_unit: decision-date / episode level; stock-day observations are dependent

dependence_method.note: Frozen before formal Stage-A OOS; applied to formal effect/significance claims, not internal tree splits.

formal_families.null: Frozen q10-q90 interval coverage and quantile calibration are not more useful than the preregistered unconditional/naive reference at the stated horizon.
formal_families.alternative: The frozen conditional quantile forecasts provide reproducible distribution information beyond the preregistered reference.
formal_families.selection_rule: All six horizons are reported. No horizon may be dropped because its result is weak.

stage3_event_probability_families.rule: Target thresholds are diagnostic queries of the frozen path distribution, not separately trained models. Every formal event/horizon query still counts in multiplicity accounting.

notes: This registry remains draft until Stage-0 data/PIT audit and SOURCE FREEZE are complete. Formal OOS must fail closed while status is not LOCKED.
